full_prompt_en: A square delicate storybook illustration shows a blond child crouching among tall dandelion seed heads against a nearly black night garden. The dark background fills the upper half and is speckled with tiny pale dots, fine twigs and barely visible foliage. On the left, several slender stems rise to round white puffballs, each seed drawn in fine radiating strokes. The child sits near the lower-left center, barefoot on a small pale patch of ground with knees tucked under a muted olive skirt. A loose cream blouse with short fluttering sleeves brightens the shoulders. Her golden hair is swept back into a low soft coil, and she faces right in profile, leaning toward a small seed head near her raised hand. One finger or short stem touches the air before her mouth as if she is about to blow the seeds. On the right, a particularly large white dandelion sphere rises above angular pale green leaves and more fine stems. Small white blossoms cluster along the lower edges, and scattered seeds drift into the surrounding dark. The drawing uses precise thin ink lines for plants and hair, with softly flat cream, olive and straw-gold color over an aged-paper texture. Illumination is quiet and moonlike, making the white seed heads and blouse glow while leaving the background almost black. The overall composition balances the child's compact warm figure with an airy vertical constellation of pale botanical circles and stems.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、纤巧的故事书插画里，一名金发孩子蹲在高高的蒲公英绒球间，背后几乎是黑色夜园。深背景填满上半部，散着细小浅点、纤枝和几乎不可见的叶。左侧，几根细茎升向圆白绒球，每颗种子由细放射线描出。孩子位于左下中部附近，赤脚蹲在一小片浅地上，双膝收在压低橄榄色裙下。宽松奶油色上衣有短短飘动的袖，提亮肩膀。金发向后拢成低而柔的发团，她以侧脸朝右，身体向抬起手旁的一颗小种头倾去。一根手指或短茎在嘴前触及空气，仿佛即将吹走种子。右侧一颗特别大的白蒲公英球高过尖角浅绿叶和更多细茎。小白花聚在下缘，散种飘入周围黑暗。绘画以精确细墨线描写植物与发丝，在旧纸肌理上覆盖柔平的奶油、橄榄与稻金色。照明安静而似月光，让白绒球和上衣发亮，背景近黑。整体构图让孩子紧凑的暖色形体与通透的浅色植物圆球和竖茎星座相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The storybook illustration pairs fine botanical ink linework with quiet matte color on an aged grainy support. A deep charcoal field gives cream-white round marks and pale narrow strokes exceptional clarity; muted olive and straw gold add gentle warmth. Dense detail is concentrated in delicate branching clusters, while the central darkness remains spacious. Edges are crisp in the thinnest forms and softly shaded inside larger color masses. Low diffuse light seems to make pale surfaces glow without hard cast shadows. The composition has a vertical, airy rhythm and a tender nocturnal mood, with meticulous detail held by generous negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种故事书插画把纤细植物式墨线与旧颗粒载体上的安静哑光颜色结合。深炭色域让奶油白圆形笔痕和浅色窄线格外清楚；压低橄榄和稻金添温和暖意。密集细节聚在纤巧分枝簇群，中央黑暗仍宽敞。最细形体的边缘清脆，大色团内部柔和着阴影。低而漫射的光似让浅色表面发亮，却没有硬投影。构图有竖向通透节奏和温柔夜色气氛，精密细节被宽裕负空间托住。
theme_en: A blond girl crouching beside glowing dandelion seed heads at night
theme_zh: 金发女孩在夜色中蹲在发亮的蒲公英绒球旁
name: Ida Rentoul Outhwaite
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
